cd /work/tmp && python3 -c "
def r(v):
    h='%032x'%v
    return ':'.join(h[i:i+4] for i in range(0,32,4))
with open('/work/tmp/over.fib','w') as f:
    for i in range(200001):
        f.write('%s/64 %d\n' % (r(i<<64), i))
with open('/work/tmp/exact.fib','w') as f:
    for i in range(200000):
        f.write('%s/64 %d\n' % (r(i<<64), i))
with open('/work/tmp/over.tr','w') as f:
    for i in range(1000001):
        f.write('%s\n' % r(i<<64))
with open('/work/tmp/exact.tr','w') as f:
    for i in range(1000000):
        f.write('%s\n' % r(i<<64))
"
/work/submit/planb64 build over.fib /tmp/over.idx; echo "over-fib rc=$?"
/work/submit/planb64 lookup ok.idx over.tr scalar > /dev/null; echo "over-trace rc=$?"
/work/submit/planb64 build exact.fib /tmp/exact.idx; echo "exact-fib rc=$? rows=$(( $(wc -l < /tmp/exact.idx) - 2 ))"
time /work/submit/planb64 lookup /tmp/exact.idx exact.tr batch 128 | tail -1
time /work/submit/planb64 lookup /tmp/exact.idx exact.tr scalar | tail -1
